events.title: Change in Key Managerial Personnel - Appointment of Chief Financial Officer
events.summary: Board approved the appointment of Mr. Siddharth Kapadia as Chief Financial Officer and KMP with effect from December 1, 2026, succeeding the incumbent CFO who retires on November 30, 2026. Brief profile enclosed as per SEBI circular.

events.title: Outcome of Board Meeting - Approval of capital expenditure
events.summary: Board approved capex of Rs 2,400 crore over FY27-FY29 for a new CDMO manufacturing campus at Anakapalli, Andhra Pradesh, to be funded through internal accruals and debt.

events.title: Acquisition - Execution of definitive agreement
